statement: Producer native Rust checks construct a four-point actual-Curve25519 torus/Semaev system with M=12965132697890207, four cosets, 454 variables and 455 quadratic equations, check planted group/circuit witnesses and eight raw cofactor sections, and check six branch roots, all 36 branch ratios and an exact integer inequality used by a proposed average-energy argument. These are construction/arithmetic checks; no solver was invoked on the large-base systems, no geometric theorem or changed exponent is verified.
